articles.label: Install on Windows
articles.title: Install, upgrade and uninstall Vivary on Windows
articles.description: Download Vivary 0.1.0-beta.1 for Windows, verify its checksum, install it without administrator rights, start it, and upgrade or uninstall it.
articles.summary: The Vivary setup program installs the Vivary desktop app for your Windows account, without administrator rights.

articles.label: Runtimes and keys
articles.title: Set up coding runtimes and provider keys
articles.description: Connect Claude Code or Codex to Vivary, choose Codex permissions, and add the provider keys that Native chat and automation conditions use.
articles.summary: A coding runtime is a coding agent program, Claude Code or Codex, that you install on your computer and that Vivary uses for Code conversations.

articles.label: Projects
articles.title: Open and set up projects
articles.description: Open a folder or create a project in Vivary, set up an existing folder, reconnect a moved folder, and use Files, search, health and Memory.
articles.summary: A project is a folder on your computer that Vivary and your agents work in.

articles.label: Conversations
articles.title: Work in conversations
articles.description: Start Code conversations and Native chats in Vivary, choose a runtime and model, answer Codex requests, stop a run, link, archive and search conversations.
articles.summary: A conversation is a series of messages between you and an agent in one project.

articles.label: Handoffs
articles.title: Save a handoff to STATE.md
articles.description: Use Prepare handoff and Save handoff in Vivary to record goals, decisions and next steps in the state document of a project, and keep that record current.
articles.summary: A handoff is a work summary from the agent that Vivary saves at the end of the state document, such as STATE.md.

articles.label: Automations
articles.title: Run automations
articles.description: Create Vivary automations that run on a schedule, after an event or from a local webhook, run them now, approve protected actions, and review file changes.
articles.summary: An automation is a saved instruction that the agent runs on a schedule, after an event, or from a webhook call.

articles.label: Remote access
articles.title: Open Vivary on another device
articles.description: Turn on Vivary remote access over a protected HTTPS connection that you set up, pair a browser on another device, and revoke or turn off access.
articles.summary: Remote access lets a browser on a different device open the Vivary app that runs on this computer.

articles.label: Troubleshooting
articles.title: Troubleshoot Vivary
articles.description: Correct common Vivary problems: installer messages, launch failures, coding runtimes that are not ready, unavailable projects, stopped runs and automation errors.
articles.summary: This troubleshooting guide lists the problems that you can see in Vivary and the action that corrects each one.
